description: Defines the structure and functions for managing a data buffer (`git_buf`) in libgit2, including memory management, resizing, and content checks.

methods.name: git_buf_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the buffer's data, without freeing the `git_buf` structure itself.

methods.name: git_buf_grow
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to at least the target size, expanding if necessary.

methods.name: git_buf_set
methods.description: Sets the buffer's content to a copy of the provided data.

methods.name: git_buf_is_binary
methods.description: Checks if the buffer appears to contain binary data.

methods.name: git_buf_contains_nul
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contains a NUL byte.
